cues.en: Okay, so we have our command all set up and we're ready to give this a try.
cues.zh: 命令設定好了，準備實際測試。

cues.en: And if you look over here in my Documents folder, you'll see that it's empty.
cues.zh: 看看我的 documents 資料夾，裡面是空的。

cues.en: There's nothing in Documents and there's nothing in Processed.
cues.zh: documents 沒東西，processed 也沒東西，

cues.en: I moved all of those out.
cues.zh: 我把檔案全部移走了。

cues.en: So first of all, let's make sure we can actually start this application, okay?
cues.zh: 首先確認應用程式真的能啟動。

cues.en: So I open my terminal, I'm in my virtual environment, and I'm going to type pyreg watch and hope for the best.
cues.zh: 開啟終端機，已在虛擬環境中，輸入 pyrag watch，希望順利。

cues.en: Okay, so it skipped an unsupported file.
cues.zh: 它跳過了一個不支援的檔案，

cues.en: Docs have invisible files called ds underscore store, so it skipped that.
cues.zh: Mac 會有名為 .DS_Store 的隱藏檔，所以將它跳過。

cues.en: The initial scan worked, okay?
cues.zh: 初始掃描成功了，

cues.en: Didn't find anything to put in there, but that's great, at least it worked.
cues.zh: 雖然沒找到可匯入的內容，但至少程式能運作，很好。

cues.en: And now we're watching the Documents folder.
cues.zh: 現在正在監看 documents 資料夾。

cues.en: So you can't see me do this, but I'm going to come over here and I'm going to drag a file called guardian.txt and drop it into the Documents folder. Here we go.
cues.zh: 你看不到我拖曳的動作，但我要把 guardian.txt 拖進 documents。現在放進去，

cues.en: So I dropped it in and there, it got processed.
cues.zh: 檔案已放入，並且處理完成。

cues.en: Now let's make sure it's actually in the Processed folder, okay?
cues.zh: 確認它真的在 processed 裡，

cues.en: So if I go to Documents, there's guardian.txt inside of the Processed folder.
cues.zh: 進入 documents，可以看到 guardian.txt 已移到 processed。

cues.en: Now let's make sure it's actually in the database.
cues.zh: 再確認它真的在資料庫裡。

cues.en: So I'll go over to Postico or you use whatever Postgres client you have, and I have the database open and I'm going to refresh the screen, and there, it found the file guardian.txt.
cues.zh: 我到 Postico，你可以用自己的 Postgres 用戶端。開啟資料庫、重新整理畫面，就找到 guardian.txt 了。

cues.en: And apparently it has five chunks and it's got an ID of 11.
cues.zh: 看來它有五個區塊，ID 是 11。

cues.en: So let's go to the Chunks table and make sure those chunks are actually there.
cues.zh: 接著到 chunks 表，確認那些區塊真的存在。

cues.en: And I'll scroll to the bottom and there are five chunks about this creature.
cues.zh: 捲到最下面，這裡有五個關於這種生物的區塊。

cues.en: Now if you look very closely, you'll see that this has the title, the Quirexal, Guardian of the Luminous Marshes, okay?
cues.zh: 仔細看，標題是「Quirexal，發光沼澤的守護者」。

cues.en: So Quirexal is an entirely fictional word. I made that up.
cues.zh: Quirexal 完全是個虛構詞，是我編出來的。

cues.en: And I wrote a short document about the fictitious creature, the Quirexal, which you won't find if you search on Google or anywhere else because it comes purely out of my imagination.
cues.zh: 我寫了一篇關於虛構生物 Quirexal 的短文，你在 Google 或其他地方都找不到，因為它完全來自我的想像。

cues.en: Let's see if this actually works.
cues.zh: 看看實際能否運作，

cues.en: So I'm going to leave the watcher running.
cues.zh: 我先讓監看器繼續跑，

cues.en: There's no reason to stop it right now.
cues.zh: 現在沒有理由停止。

cues.en: I'm going to open a new terminal window, okay?
cues.zh: 開一個新的終端機視窗，

cues.en: And I'll go source.
cues.zh: 然後輸入 source，

cues.en: Oh, it already did it for me.
cues.zh: 噢，它已經自動幫我完成了。

cues.en: So now I'm in my virtual environment. Perfect.
cues.zh: 所以現在在虛擬環境裡，很好。

cues.en: And I'm going to try a chat, Pyreg chat, okay?
cues.zh: 來試聊天，輸入 pyrag chat。

cues.en: So ready to ask my question.
cues.zh: 準備提出問題，

cues.en: And I'll ask, what is a Quirexal?
cues.zh: 我問：「什麼是 Quirexal？」

cues.en: And I'm hoping this will do what I expect it to do.
cues.zh: 希望它如我預期運作。

cues.en: So it searches the vector store, it builds the new response or question, sends it there, and it says, I don't have any information about a Quirexal in the provided context.
cues.zh: 它搜尋向量儲存區、建立新的回覆或問題，再送給模型，卻說提供的上下文中沒有任何 Quirexal 資訊。

cues.en: And yet it's there.
cues.zh: 但資料明明在裡面。

cues.en: I mean, I can come up here and look at guardian.txt, and there it is, the Quirexal, exactly the same spelling.
cues.zh: 我可以到這裡查看 guardian.txt，Quirexal 就在這裡，拼字完全相同。

cues.en: So why didn't it find it?
cues.zh: 那為什麼沒找到？

cues.en: Well, the answer is pretty simple.
cues.zh: 答案其實很簡單。

cues.en: Our dense search, our cosine similarity search, it's not perfect.
cues.zh: 稠密向量搜尋，也就是餘弦相似度搜尋，並不完美。

cues.en: And in certain situations, particularly where it encounters a word that the actual LLM we're embedding into, where that word doesn't exist, sometimes it just can't find things.
cues.zh: 有些情況下，尤其碰到建立嵌入的模型原本不知道的字詞時，它有時就找不到內容。

cues.en: And the simplest and most effective way to overcome that limitation is to implement something called hybrid search.
cues.zh: 克服這個限制最簡單而有效的方式，就是實作所謂混合搜尋。

cues.en: And hybrid search actually works very well with dense search or any other method of searching a database, a vector store.
cues.zh: 混合搜尋很適合搭配稠密向量搜尋，或其他資料庫、向量儲存區的搜尋方式。

cues.en: And what we're going to do in the next section is actually implement hybrid search, which will make a RAG system much more effective in terms of retrieving information, particularly
cues.zh: 下一節會真正實作混合搜尋，讓 RAG 系統檢索資訊更有效，尤其針對

cues.en: things like this, where I'm searching for a term that the LLM actually doesn't know about, okay?
cues.zh: 這類模型本身並不知道的詞彙。

cues.en: And in a lot of cases, when you're adding things to a RAG store, you're adding information that you want the LLM to know about, so it's almost certainly in some cases going to encounter
cues.zh: 很多時候，把資訊加入 RAG 儲存區，就是想讓 LLM 知道這些資訊，所以在某些情況下幾乎一定會碰到

cues.en: words that it doesn't otherwise know.
cues.zh: 原本不知道的詞。

cues.en: So let's move on to the next section and get started on hybrid search and hybrid retrieval.
cues.zh: 我們繼續下一節，開始實作混合搜尋與混合檢索。
